clips.title: The story
paras: In Mulgore, tainted wells threaten the water that sustains the tauren and local wildlife. Mull Thunderhorn in Bloodhoof Village asks young Horde defenders to gather parts from the plains for a cleansing totem.

Goblin interlopers and their lackeys have tainted Mulgore's wells, threatening the water that sustains the tauren tribes and local wildlife. Mull Thunderhorn, an elder in Bloodhoof Village, has discovered the pollution. For the tauren, who recently settled here, the wells are vital to life on these sacred plains.

Mull turns to tauren shamanism to cleanse the Winterhoof Water Well. He needs a ritual totem made with the strength of Mulgore's native beasts. You gather paws from prairie wolves and talons from mature plainstriders on the southwestern plains, bringing the land's own strength to bear against the pollution.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Goblins and their servants have tainted our sacred water wells! We cannot allow this.
To cleanse each well, I must create a cleansing totem, then you must bring the totem to the well and perform a cleansing ritual.

First we will create a cleansing totem for the Winterhoof Water Well. To do this, the land must offer its aid. Hunt prairie wolves for their paws and adult plainstriders for their talons. They are to the southwest.
Return to me with the paws and talons, friend.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the paws and talons, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have done well, friend. I will take these and bind their power into a totem of cleansing.
